title: agency_archive:{agency_id}:{page_url}
description: JSON stamp of the Internet Archive reading of one page
x-issues: I09 (writers_disagree): kv agency_archive stamps: 6 kv_set sites in agencies.py write different key sets ({at, as_of, rev?}, {at, rev?} without as_of, stamp | {tried, since}); export_state_meetings reads as_of, so a body whose newest stamp came from the {at} path loses archive_as_of

at.description: day the copy was read; absent when only tried

as_of.description: copy capture day; NOT written by the 'no copy taken' path (agencies.py ~1713: {at}|{rev})

rev.description: READER_REV of the reader that read it (only when >1)
